subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal text/html stubs trigger best-effort Graph media lookup by default to recover channel and group-chat attachments?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes when Teams messages can request a Graph token and message fetch, which is an operator-visible behavior tradeoff rather than a pure local code cleanup.

options.title: Land the linked plugin fix
options.body: Accept the default Graph fallback for non-personal text/html stubs and land the open PR after normal exact-head checks.

options.title: Require an explicit opt-in
options.body: Ask for a config or setup-controlled gate before ordinary Teams channel/group stubs can start Graph media fetches.

options.title: Hold for more tenant variants
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until maintainers see additional live proof for group chats, private/shared channels, and permission-denied behavior.

recommendation.title: Land the linked plugin fix
recommendation.body: Accept the default Graph fallback for non-personal text/html stubs and land the open PR after normal exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about plugin boundary and operator-facing Teams behavior, and Peter Steinberger has substantial history on the Teams plugin boundary and attachment hardening path.
